answer: The dawn test I would run is Proof of unique model aircraft club field log: flights logged at one field for three years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the anchor compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The cedar grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
